indefinido.name: Preterite
indefinido.use: Finished actions at a specific time in the past.

imperfecto.name: Imperfect
imperfecto.use: Background, habits and descriptions in the past.

perfecto.name: Present perfect
perfecto.use: Past actions connected to now: today, this week, ever.

futuro.name: Future
futuro.use: What will happen, or a guess about now.

subjuntivoImperfecto.name: Imperfect subjunctive
subjuntivoImperfecto.use: Hypotheses and wishes about the past: “si yo fuera…”.

conj.ctaTitle: Know the forms. Now use them.
conj.ctaText: Tables are a start. Practise “{verb}” in short lessons with real voices, dialogues and stories – five minutes a day, free.

gram.indexLead: The topics every learner trips over, explained with clear rules, real examples, typical mistakes and a quick quiz.

gram.quizText: Pick the right option. You get an explanation straight away.
gram.ctaText: In the lessons you practise them in dialogues, listening and writing – and Hablena shows you right away what’s correct.

install.title: Hablena as an app
install.text: Put Hablena on your home screen – it opens like a real app, no app store needed.
install.ios: In Safari, tap “Share”, then “Add to Home Screen”.

course.text: Every lesson takes about five minutes and mixes listening, matching, building sentences, writing and real dialogues. Your progress, streak and daily goal keep you going, without ads and without hearts that run out.
course.castText: Hablena introduces every new word. Lucía, Mateo, Sofía and Pablo speak the exercises, so you get used to different voices from day one.

features.title: Write it yourself
features.text: Type your answers with one-tap accents. Forget an accent or make a tiny typo and Hablena tells you, without failing you for it.

features.title: Real dialogues
features.text: Answer the characters the way you would in Spain: at the café, the hotel, the market.

features.title: A guide for every unit
features.text: The few rules that matter, explained in two minutes, with examples you can listen to.

features.title: Practice that adapts
features.text: Mixed reviews from the lessons you have finished, whenever you have five minutes.

home.heroLead: Five minutes a day. Real voices, real conversations, no cramming. Try it right here, no sign-up needed.

faq.a: For anyone starting from zero or brushing up their school Spanish. The course starts at A1 and explains everything in English or German.

faq.q: How much time do I need?
faq.a: A lesson takes about five minutes. Do one a day and you will make fast progress.
Right now everything is free. Premium will cost €9.99 a month, or €59.99 a year.
No. Hablena runs in your browser, on your phone, tablet and computer.

faq.q: Spanish from Spain or Latin America?
faq.a: The course follows the Spanish spoken in Spain, which you will be understood with everywhere Spanish is spoken.

home.finalText: Your first conversation is five minutes away.

story.title: A lesson fits into any coffee break.

story.title: You talk to people, not flashcards.

story.title: You write. Hablena helps.
story.text: Forgot an accent, made a tiny typo? Still counts, and you pick up the right spelling along the way.

story.title: Every lesson ends with a win.
story.text: XP, accuracy, streak: you see right away what you achieved. And tomorrow you will want more.
